content.short: Verite provides identity verification in Web3 without exposing personal information.
content.description: Verite provides identity verification for web apps, mobile apps, and smart contracts without exposing sensitive personal information. It enables organizations, entities, and individuals to control when, how, and where identity attributes are shared. Developers can use Verite's composable tools to issue and verify credentials and to craft privacy-preserving solutions that allow access to highly secure platforms without compromising user privacy.
content.meta: Verite verifies identity for web/mobile apps and smart contracts without exposing personal data. Discover Verite and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
